What does São Paulo really cost in 2026?
• Metro ride: about US$ 1, just tap your card
• MASP: free on Tuesdays (US$ 16 other days)
• Farol Santander view: US$ 8.40
• Ramen in Liberdade: US$ 8–12
4 days from US$ 265 per person, budget style.
